_comment: PUT /providers/{id}/credentials and PUT /providers/{id}/conversion-key (SDD §12, §13.3): what the API's request models (ProviderCredentialsRequest, ConversionKeyRequest; extra fields forbidden) refuse from the body alone - before the route looks the provider up, so for a provider it does not know too - then the 404 a valid body gets, and for a known provider the route's own checks. "known" is an OpenStack provider of each side. A 422's message is validation_message over pydantic's errors: the model's fields in their order, then the extra inputs, five at most; a length counts code points. Shared by seamless/tests/test_provider_management.py and dashboard/src/api/mock.test.ts (review RV23-03).
